description: This source file defines a PHP class `Translation` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Design`. The class extends a system controller and provides multiple methods to manage translation data, including listing, editing, and saving translations within the admin interface of an OpenCart store. It handles HTTP requests, loads models for database interaction, and renders views for the user interface.
